news.title: Smartworks leases 1.41 lakh sq ft in NCR; IWG opens four new Regus centres
news.para: Smartworks leased 1.41 lakh sq ft in Aerocity, Delhi, reporting strong revenue growth. The company has a significant secured footprint across India and Singapore. IWG opened four new Regus centers in Noida, Bengaluru, and Hyderabad. These additions expand IWG's flexible workspace network in India. IWG plans over 325 centers in India within three to five years.

news.title: Bhubaneswar civic body notice to 4,632 city homes over illegal commercial use
news.para: In a decisive move, Bhubaneswar Municipal Corporation has reached out to 4,632 homeowners potentially breaking regulations by running commercial enterprises from their residences. Each homeowner has a month to provide evidence of their property's usage. Failing to comply could lead to the sealing of properties marked unauthorized. The civic body has also submitted a report on these actions to the Supreme Court.

news.title: Indore administration demolishes colony being developed illegally
news.para: In a decisive action, district authorities demolished an unauthorized residential settlement in Pipliya Rao village, reclaiming nearly two acres of valuable government land worth Rs 30 crore. This site had been illegally occupied by Nirbhay and Lalu Nagar, who were not only selling plots but also operating a flour processing facility. The administration effectively dismantled the entire layout and removed the industrial setup to restore the integrity of public land.

news.title: Gujarat: Draft rules bar PG facilities in new apartment blocks
news.para: Gujarat is set to revise its development control regulations by creating formal categories for PG facilities and preschools. The new rules prohibit the inclusion of PG accommodations in residential and commercial buildings, while preschools will fall under a designated 'Education-1' category with distinct construction requirements. This initiative aims to eliminate confusion and legal issues relating to these establishments. The state encourages public feedback until October 3.

news.title: Chandigarh's old housing societies seek relief from waste processing mandate
news.para: In Chandigarh, older housing societies face challenges adapting to new waste management regulations. With limited space for on-site processing facilities, residents advocate for a tailored compliance framework for their complexes. They express readiness to implement effective waste segregation and collection practices while requesting physical verification before any enforcement measures are enacted.

news.title: RBI keeps policy rate unchanged for third time in row amid West Asia crisis
news.para: The Reserve Bank of India maintained its key interest rates unchanged for the third consecutive time. This decision was made as the central bank considered global energy price uncertainties and supply disruptions. Inflation has now crossed the RBI's target, yet growth forecasts were slightly increased. The Indian rupee has experienced continuous depreciation against the US dollar this year. This currency decline is attributed to expensive oil and capital outflows.

news.title: Income tax department attaches prime Gopanpally land parcels over benami deals
news.para: The income tax department has taken action by attaching three land parcels estimated at ₹5.52 crore. These acquisitions by registered holders occurred without any payment. Investigators uncovered that the ownership-like rights were obtained through irrevocable general power of attorney agreements. The identity of the beneficial owners remains a mystery due to the inability to trace funding sources.

news.title: Delhi HC expresses concern over “uninhabitable” condition of JNNURM flats
news.para: The Delhi High Court raised alarms regarding the uninhabitable apartments constructed under the JNNURM scheme. With an investment of two thousand crore rupees, these flats have stood empty for years. Authorities failed to house any residents, indulging in a misuse of taxpayer funds. DUSIB attributed this issue to neglect and diminishing interest, prompting the court to scrutinize the squandering of public resources on these initiatives.

news.title: Director of 32nd Milestone, wife held in Kolkata for allegedly cheating investor
news.para: Gurgaon police detained a director of a commercial complex and his wife, charging them with fraud against an investor for about twenty-eight lakh rupees. The couple is alleged to have misrepresented property dimensions and provided false guarantees on rental income. Four others have been apprehended as part of this expanding investigation, with more victims alleging similar deceitful practices.

news.title: Mhada lottery for 2,640 Mumbai flats to be held on August 6
news.para: Mhada is scheduled to run a computerized lottery on Thursday, August 6, for 2,640 tenements starting at noon at Rangsharda Auditorium in Bandra. This round features flats located in diverse areas of Mumbai such as Vikhroli and Goregaon, inclusive of 319 unsold flats from previous events. Notably, Mhada has adjusted prices downwards and set aside flats specifically for the High Income Group, enhancing opportunities for applicants.

news.title: Faridabad: 32 years on, HSVP pays ₹52 crore for colonies on forest land
news.para: Haryana Shehri Vikas Pradhikaran is taking important steps to remedy forest land diversion in Faridabad. The authority has deposited Rs 52 crore and plans to allocate 135.5 hectares for afforestation efforts. This action, following central government approval, addresses the ex-post facto diversion of forest land that was previously utilized for residential and public infrastructure without proper clearances, all in an effort to comply with forest conservation regulations.

news.title: Bungalows in Gujarat capped at 12 metres in proposed CGDCR revamp
news.para: On July 28, 2026, Gujarat's Urban Development Department introduced amendments to the CGDCR, establishing a height limit of twelve meters for bungalow constructions. Structures exceeding this height will now adhere to the regulations set for apartments, effectively preventing the approval of bungalow developments packaged as apartments. Additionally, offices within bungalows up to twelve meters can utilize up to fifty square meters for professional use.

news.title: Lutyens Delhi's rents are touching ₹20 lakh per month & there're no homes for sale
news.para: Luxury rentals in Delhi's Lutyens Bungalow Zone are soaring as a severe shortage of homes for sale pushes affluent families, diplomats and corporate executives towards leasing premium properties. Rentals in areas such as Golf Links and Sunder Nagar have doubled in some pockets over the past few years, with monthly rents touching ₹20 lakh amid tight supply and robust demand.

news.title: Delhi development body extends deadline for Narela flats till August 31
news.para: The Delhi Development Authority has extended the housing scheme deadlines in Narela until August 31. The Nagrik Awas Yojana has already seen a surge in interest, booking over 2,000 flats since January. Plans are in place for additional high-income group (HIG) and middle-income group (MIG) flats. Meanwhile, the Karmayogi Awas Yojana has successfully sold 2,274 flats, with ongoing construction projects to meet demand.

news.title: Balcony ceiling collapses in Gurugram society, buyers allege negligence by builder, demand probe
news.para: On Tuesday, the ceiling of a kitchen balcony collapsed at Mapsko Royal Ville in Gurugram, igniting fears among residents about the structural integrity of their complex. They raised alarms over unresolved issues flagged in a prior structural audit, accusing the developer of negligence. With safety increasingly in doubt, residents are now calling for an independent inspection and pursuing legal action to ensure necessary repairs are undertaken.

news.title: Tax exemption can’t be denied for builder’s delay: Telangana HC
news.para: The Telangana High Court confirmed the validity of Section 54F's taxpayer exemptions, underscoring that delays in construction or registration by developers should not hinder claimed benefits. The court reiterated the importance of reinvesting capital gains in residential property, deeming it illegal to deny exemptions based on external factors. Taxpayers can now confidently navigate exemptions despite any construction challenges.

news.title: Ajmera Realty's profit rises 14% to ₹45 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: Ajmera Realty & Infra India Ltd announced a fourteen percent profit increase.  This growth occurred for the quarter ending in June, reaching forty-four point nine four crore.  Total income also saw a rise to three hundred nineteen point fifty-two crore.  This marks an improvement from the previous year's corresponding period.  The Mumbai-based company is a leading real estate firm.

news.title: Sebi mulls allowing depository receipts against REIT, publicly listed InvIT units
news.para: Sebi proposed allowing Depository Receipts for Real Estate Investment Trusts units. This move aims to attract foreign capital and widen investment options. Publicly listed Infrastructure Investment Trusts will also be included in this framework. Privately listed InvITs, however, will remain outside this proposed regulation. Public comments on these proposals are due by August 25.

news.title: NGT directs recovery of ₹10 crore from Godwin Construction for failure to manage sewage
news.para: The National Green Tribunal ordered Uttar Pradesh authorities to recover ten crore rupees compensation. This amount is for a property developer's failure in managing sewage and solid waste. The tribunal noted the developer did not construct a mandatory sewage treatment plant. Local commissioner reports confirmed ongoing sewage overflow and stagnation risks. The recovered compensation will fund the construction of a new sewage treatment plant.

news.title: Prateek Group to invest ₹500 crore in Ghaziabad high-street mall
news.para: Prateek Group plans to develop a two lakh sq ft high-street mall in Siddharth Vihar, Ghaziabad, with an investment of about ₹500 crore. The project will follow a 100% lease-based model, with the company retaining ownership of the asset.
